purpose: Prospective power extension of the frozen natural-MCQA protocol
eligibility_rule: full-context correct AND gold-only correct AND no-context incorrect
primary_contrast: utility-selected source_max minus displacement-matched distractor control margin
test: two-sided exact sign-flip test over six seed means
success_rule: all six seeds pass competence, all six margin contrasts are positive, and exact two-sided p < 0.05
frozen_protocol: No prompt, selector, competence, generation, or intervention rule changes from natural_mcqa_v2_context_dependent.
